name: Entity Association
description: Associate entities together with definable behaviors, landing pages and contexts.

suggests.drupal/pathauto: Generate and maintain path aliases for associations and their content.

project_description: Entity Association provides a content entity ('association') that groups other content entities together and governs them with pluggable behavior rules. A behavior plugin decides which entity types/bundles may be added to an association, their cardinality and ordering, and builds the content-management admin UI. Entities joined to an association gain a shared context so blocks, banners and menus can react to the active association. Associations can also run entity updaters over their members (e.g. maintain a pathauto alias, propagate active/published status, or reindex in Search API). The project is extensible through behavior plugins, landing-page handler plugins, YAML-declared entity adapters, tagged association negotiators, and several events. Three optional submodules add auto-generation of member entities (association_autogen), per-association menus and breadcrumbs (association_menu), and a revisionable dedicated landing-page entity (association_page).
